stories.title: Man arrested after trying to break into a Brooksville radio station
stories.summary: A man faces charges after attempting to break into a Brooksville radio station, according to the Hernando County Sheriff's Office.

stories.title: Feeding Tampa Bay serves Thanksgiving meals to thousands of families
stories.summary: Feeding Tampa Bay is serving up all the Thanksgiving favorites to about two thousand families across the Bay Area this holiday.

stories.title: VIDEO: Deputies search for 5 suspects linked to $330K heist at a Tampa boutique shop
stories.summary: The Hillsborough County Sheriff's Office released a roughly 1-minute video footage showing the moment of the crash-and-grab burglary in a Tampa store.

stories.title: Deadly Thanksgiving shooting renews calls for stronger short-term rental regulations in Florida
stories.summary: A deadly Thanksgiving morning shooting at a Polk County Airbnb is renewing calls for stronger safety regulations at short-term rental properties across Florida.

stories.title: 1 dead, 6 injured in Thanksgiving shooting at teen party in Davenport Airbnb; sheriff blames negligence
stories.summary: Polk County Sheriff Judd says the alleged shooter was a gang member with 76 criminal and misdemeanor charges.

stories.title: Woman whose G-Wagon was stolen says hotel showed 'little regard' for incident
stories.summary: Stella Stolper claims hotel management hadn't made any effort to contact her following the theft of her Mercedes G-Wagon until after her story made the news.

stories.title: Tampa Bay-area DUI attorney uses TikTok to raise awareness about drunk driving
stories.summary: C.J. Bauer estimates that 75% of the people he interviews underestimate their level of intoxication.

stories.title: Man dead after shooting in Riverview; deputies investigating
stories.summary: Deputies responded to a call about the shooting on Pradera Reserve Boulevard, where they say they found the man with at least one gunshot wound to the upper body.

stories.title: St. Pete Mayor-elect Charlie Crist to launch 'Community Conversations' series, inviting residents to speak up
stories.summary: Crist is hosting a series events to talk with residents on issues like policy priorities, public services to protect amid Amendment 3, storm resilience, and more.

stories.title: Traffic homicide detectives investigate fatal Lakeland crash where man died after slamming into tree
stories.summary: A 44-year-old man died after his truck crashed into an oak tree and burst into flames. The Polk County Sheriff's Office is investigating the high-speed incident.

stories.title: From planning a wedding to a funeral: Family of bride-to-be killed in Courtney Campbell crash calls for change
stories.summary: The accused driver had a previous DUI conviction and was released from jail just four days before the deadly crash, court records show.

stories.title: Tampa Bay ranks third nationally for road-related vehicle repairs, Pep Boys report finds
stories.summary: As millions travel for Thanksgiving, a new report ranks Tampa Bay among the worst for road-related vehicle repairs.
